mechanism: Opening the dataset sync page unconditionally re-downloads the full classic-poem dataset JSON and re-runs the bulk import, even when the (static, versioned) dataset is already fully imported. Every re-import re-attempts thousands of inserts that all conflict with existing rows (id primary key), wasting network transfer, parsing, and database work on each visit.
fix_summary: Before importing, a single COUNT query checks whether the dataset is already present and skips the download/import entirely when the table is populated.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
